messages:
dave-oncall: Heads up — incident-assistant failed to page our rotation at 16:12 UTC. Noticed a burst of 502s from the notify webhook. I started manual paging.
incident-assistant: automated: delivery failed: status=502, event_id=ev-9d1c, retries=3, reason=upstream_error
carla-sre: How long was the gap? any customer reports yet? @maya-support
maya-support: Two customers opened support tickets (acme-inc, beta-app). They saw 5-10s timeouts on inference endpoints and a couple of user-facing errors. Not a P0 but customer-visible. Tickets: https://support/redwood/INC-5421, https://support/redwood/INC-5422
elena-eng: digging into logs now — notify-proxy -> inc-assistant returned 502 with body "invalid payload". Quick snippet:
```
POST /webhook/inc-assistant 502
{"error":"payload size > 64kb","received_bytes":72104}
```
jonathan-ops: That payload size rings a bell — we recently started attaching eval traces to alerts. Looks like some traces are >64kb and the connector rejects them. Immediate mitigation options: 1) trim payloads at producer, 2) route to short-alert path, 3) increase accept limit (risky).
carla-sre: I sent a manual page to the oncall rotation at 16:16 UTC to cover while we triage. Confirmed delivered. Will keep manual pages until automated path stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-assistant: deploy-bot: notify-proxy rolling restart initiated on prod-1 at 16:20 UTC (service: notify-proxy-prod-1)
deploy-bot: restart step 1/3 complete
elena-eng: Quick hotfix: patch bridge to drop large eval blobs and include a 3-line summary. Pushing change to prod-1 now. Command used:
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/notify-proxy DROP_LARGE_ALERTS=true SUMMARY_TRIM=3
```
dave-oncall: Mitigation in place — bridging now returns 200 for truncated alerts. Added a temporary retry loop (3 attempts) on failed webhook deliveries. Monitoring for 15m.
maya-support: I updated both customer tickets with timeline and workaround. acme-inc reported errors stopped after manual workaround. beta-app still saw a few failures but not after 16:24.
elena-eng: Root cause hypothesis: the eval instrumentation change (PR #4823) started attaching untrimmed traces to alert payloads. We missed an outbound payload size guard. Rolling back the instrumentation to staging and preparing a targeted hotfix to add validation and unit tests.
jonathan-ops: Owners: elena-eng (hotfix + tests), carla-sre (operational mitigation + runbook update), maya-support (customer comms). Action items:
- enforce producer-side payload limit (72h)
- add integration test for oversized webhook payloads (eta 2 days)
- make incidentbot surface webhook non-2xx as channel-wide alert (instead of only thread-level)
- add metric for webhook reject-by-size
carla-sre: I'll add the runbook step to manually trigger /manual-page and include the trimmed-summary workaround.
dave-oncall: Thanks — I'll open the postmortem doc and assign owners. No P0 escalation needed but we'll treat as high-priority operational bug. Leaving thread open until postmortem triage complete. :spiral_notepad:
